_comment: Files that must stay clean under `mypy --strict` (pyproject [tool.mypy] still applies). Enforced by `python tools/check_strict_typing.py --check`. The ratchet turns one way: add a file once it is strict-clean both with and without third-party packages visible (`--list-clean` prints candidates); removing one is a deliberate, reviewed edit. Keep the list sorted; the gate fails on unsorted, duplicate or missing entries.
